arms.E26: stop 3.0 ATR, floor 6%, refill every 5 sessions, idle cash credited
arms.baseline: stop 2.0 ATR, floor 3%, refill every 20 sessions, idle cash credited

verdict: REVERT. E26 beat the baseline in 2024-09..2025-12 but not in 2026, and the rule required both. V2_STOP_ATR_MULTIPLE, V2_MIN_STOP_PCT and V2_REBALANCE_SESSIONS are back at 2.0, 3% and 20. The idle-cash credit and the panel's fixed-income note stay, as preregistered.
reading: Wider stops and weekly refills did what they were meant to mechanically: cash fell from 80-86% to ~56% and trades more than doubled. The extra exposure went into picks that were worse than random (0-17th percentile), so in 2026 it lost money.
Every arm trails the index by 60-95 points in both windows. In 2024-09..2025-12 the best arm (+32.7%) only matched the risk-free rate (+32.4%).
Both windows were spent before E26; the 2024-25 improvement is in-sample and is not evidence of an edge.
